text: Backend: stop writing aim files from the read path
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). server.ts readAim migrates legacy fields (outgoing -> supportedAims) and replaces [0,0] relativePositions with random ones, writing the file back — during every aim.get/aim.list. Reads therefore mutate the repo (noisy .bowman diffs, races with concurrent writers/agents, nondeterministic positions). Move these migrations into an explicit, idempotent migration step (project open / fix_consistency) and make readAim pure.
